parts.title: Part 1
parts.descriptionEn: Information Technology and Society; Cybersecurity; Web Applications; Web and Media Design.
parts.descriptionAr: تكنولوجيا المعلومات والمجتمع؛ الأمن السيبراني؛ تطبيقات الويب؛ تصميم الويب والوسائط.

lessons.title: Development of Information Technology and Social Transformation

objectives.textEn: Explain the major stages in the development of information technology and their impact on society.
objectives.textAr: شرح المراحل الرئيسية في تطور تكنولوجيا المعلومات وتأثيرها على المجتمع.

objectives.textEn: Give examples of social changes and emerging technologies brought about by information technology, and explain their characteristics.
objectives.textAr: إعطاء أمثلة على التغيرات الاجتماعية والتقنيات الناشئة التي أحدثتها تكنولوجيا المعلومات، وشرح خصائصها.

lessons.knowledgeSummaryEn: Information technology advances through stages that introduce new capabilities and reshape communication, work, learning, and commerce.
cautionAndMisconceptionsEn: Do not treat one technology stage as isolated; the lesson connects technical change to social impact.

lessons.title: How AI Works

objectives.textEn: Explain what AI is.
objectives.textAr: شرح ماهية الذكاء الاصطناعي.

objectives.textEn: Explain how generative AI is positioned within AI technologies.
objectives.textAr: شرح موقع الذكاء الاصطناعي التوليدي ضمن تقنيات الذكاء الاصطناعي.

lessons.knowledgeSummaryEn: AI is the broad field; machine learning is within AI, deep learning is within machine learning, and generative AI is built on deep learning.
cautionAndMisconceptionsEn: AI, machine learning, deep learning, and generative AI are nested rather than interchangeable.
Generative AI uses learning technologies; it does not generate from no data or rules.

lessons.title: AI in Daily Life and Industry
lessons.titleAr: الذكاء الاصطناعي في الحياة اليومية والصناعة

objectives.textEn: Give examples of how AI is used in daily life and various industries.
objectives.textAr: إعطاء أمثلة على استخدام الذكاء الاصطناعي في الحياة اليومية ومختلف الصناعات.

objectives.textEn: Explain what AI is good at and what requires caution when using AI.
objectives.textAr: شرح ما يجيده الذكاء الاصطناعي وما يتطلب الحذر عند استخدامه.

lessons.knowledgeSummaryEn: AI is strong at finding patterns, recognition, generation, and probabilistic prediction, but human judgment remains necessary for ethics, privacy, responsibility, and factual reliability.
cautionAndMisconceptionsEn: Pattern recognition or prediction is not the same as ethical judgment or responsibility.
A fluent AI output can still be a hallucination.

lessons.title: Ethical Issues with AI

objectives.textEn: Explain what algorithmic bias is and describe its main causes.
objectives.textAr: شرح التحيز الخوارزمي وبيان أسبابه الرئيسية.

objectives.textEn: Connect the basic principles of AI ethics (fairness, transparency, privacy protection, and accountability) to specific situations.
objectives.textAr: ربط مبادئ أخلاقيات الذكاء الاصطناعي الأساسية (العدالة والشفافية وحماية الخصوصية والمساءلة) بمواقف محددة.

lessons.knowledgeSummaryEn: AI decisions can affect people; biased training data, opaque reasoning, privacy concerns, and unclear responsibility require explicit ethical principles.
cautionAndMisconceptionsEn: More data does not automatically remove bias if the training data is biased.
Explainability helps people inspect decisions but does not by itself assign responsibility.

lessons.title: Cryptographic Technologies and Authentication

objectives.textEn: Explain how HTTPS secures communication: how the TLS handshake uses public-key cryptography to share a key safely, and how common-key cryptography then protects the data that follows.
objectives.textAr: شرح كيفية تأمين HTTPS للاتصال؛ إذ تستخدم مصافحة TLS التشفير بالمفتاح العام لمشاركة مفتاح بأمان، ثم يحمي التشفير بالمفتاح المتماثل البيانات التالية.

objectives.textEn: Describe how authentication, including multi-factor authentication, is used in real services, and explain why security technologies are combined.
objectives.textAr: وصف كيفية استخدام المصادقة، بما فيها المصادقة متعددة العوامل، في الخدمات الحقيقية، وشرح سبب الجمع بين تقنيات الأمان.

lessons.knowledgeSummaryEn: HTTPS uses public-key cryptography during the TLS handshake and common-key cryptography for the continuing data; authentication verifies identity and can combine factors.
cautionAndMisconceptionsEn: Public-key and common-key cryptography have different roles in HTTPS.
Authentication is identity verification; using several controls is stronger than relying on one technology.

lessons.title: Network Security Design

objectives.textEn: Explain the roles of firewalls, VPNs, and DMZs in protecting a network.
objectives.textAr: شرح أدوار جدران الحماية وVPNs والمناطق منزوعة السلاح (DMZs) في حماية الشبكة.

objectives.textEn: Describe defense in depth and zero trust, and explain why layered, verified access is stronger than a single barrier.
objectives.textAr: وصف الدفاع متعدد الطبقات والثقة الصفرية، وشرح سبب قوة الوصول المتحقق منه متعدد الطبقات مقارنة بحاجز واحد.

lessons.knowledgeSummaryEn: Network security places different controls at boundaries and inside the system: firewall, VPN, DMZ, layered defense, and verified access.
cautionAndMisconceptionsEn: A VPN is not the same as a firewall or a DMZ.
Defense in depth does not mean one perimeter barrier; it layers controls and verification.

lessons.title: Incident Response and Risk Management

objectives.textEn: Explain what a security incident is and describe the stages of incident response in the correct order.
objectives.textAr: شرح ماهية الحادث الأمني ووصف مراحل الاستجابة للحوادث بالترتيب الصحيح.

objectives.textEn: Apply the idea of risk assessment by prioritizing risks according to their impact and likelihood.
objectives.textAr: تطبيق فكرة تقييم المخاطر بترتيب المخاطر وفقًا لتأثيرها واحتمالية حدوثها.

lessons.knowledgeSummaryEn: Incident response follows Preparation, Detection, Containment, Eradication, Recovery, and Prevention of recurrence; risk is prioritized by impact multiplied by likelihood.
cautionAndMisconceptionsEn: Containment comes before eradication so damage does not spread.
Risk is not determined by impact alone; likelihood also matters.

lessons.title: The Overall Structure of Web Applications

objectives.textEn: Explain what a web application is and describe the roles of its three tiers: frontend, backend, and database.
objectives.textAr: شرح ماهية تطبيق الويب ووصف أدوار طبقاته الثلاث: الواجهة الأمامية والواجهة الخلفية وقاعدة البيانات.

objectives.textEn: Trace how the three tiers cooperate to turn a user’s action into a result, using familiar services as examples.
objectives.textAr: تتبع كيفية تعاون الطبقات الثلاث لتحويل إجراء المستخدم إلى نتيجة، باستخدام خدمات مألوفة كأمثلة.

lessons.knowledgeSummaryEn: A web application coordinates the presentation/frontend, logic/backend, and data/database tiers to turn user actions into results.
cautionAndMisconceptionsEn: Frontend, backend, and database are distinct roles that cooperate; they are not interchangeable labels.

lessons.title: Web Application Communication Methods

objectives.textEn: Explain the client and server model and the difference between HTTP and HTTPS.
objectives.textAr: شرح نموذج العميل والخادم والفرق بين HTTP وHTTPS.

objectives.textEn: Describe how HTTP requests and responses work, and explain the role of an API in exchanging data.
objectives.textAr: وصف كيفية عمل طلبات واستجابات HTTP وشرح دور واجهة برمجة التطبيقات في تبادل البيانات.

lessons.knowledgeSummaryEn: Clients send requests and servers return responses; HTTP methods, status codes, APIs, and JSON organize communication, while HTTPS adds protection.
cautionAndMisconceptionsEn: HTTP and HTTPS are not interchangeable when sensitive data is involved.
An API is an exchange boundary, not a database or a frontend by itself.

lessons.title: Fundamentals of Frontend Technology

objectives.textEn: Explain the distinct roles of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript in building a web page.
objectives.textAr: شرح الأدوار المختلفة لـHTML وCSS وJavaScript في بناء صفحة ويب.

objectives.textEn: Describe how semantic HTML, responsive design, and frameworks improve a modern frontend.
objectives.textAr: وصف كيفية تحسين HTML الدلالي والتصميم المتجاوب وأطر العمل للواجهة الأمامية الحديثة.

lessons.knowledgeSummaryEn: HTML supplies structure, CSS appearance, and JavaScript behavior; semantic, responsive, accessible design supports modern frontends.
cautionAndMisconceptionsEn: HTML, CSS, and JavaScript have different responsibilities.
A framework supports frontend development; it does not replace the underlying web roles.

lessons.title: Types and Characteristics of Media

objectives.textEn: Compare the characteristics of different media, and explain the strengths and constraints of websites.
objectives.textAr: مقارنة خصائص الوسائط المختلفة وشرح نقاط قوة المواقع الإلكترونية وقيودها.

objectives.textEn: Choose suitable media for a given purpose and audience, and justify the choice.
objectives.textAr: اختيار الوسيط المناسب لغرض وجمهور محددين وتبرير الاختيار.

lessons.knowledgeSummaryEn: Media differ in reach, interaction, and constraints; a suitable choice depends on purpose and audience and may combine media.
cautionAndMisconceptionsEn: No medium is universally best; suitability depends on the purpose and audience.

lessons.title: Information Design and User Experience for Websites

objectives.textEn: Explain how personas and wireframes are used to plan a website before designing its appearance.
objectives.textAr: شرح كيفية استخدام شخصيات المستخدم والمخططات الهيكلية لتخطيط الموقع قبل تصميم مظهره.

objectives.textEn: Apply the four principles of design (contrast, repetition, alignment, proximity) and explain the idea of user-centered design.
objectives.textAr: تطبيق مبادئ التصميم الأربعة (التباين والتكرار والمحاذاة والتقارب) وشرح فكرة التصميم المتمحور حول المستخدم.

lessons.knowledgeSummaryEn: Good information design starts from user needs: persona, wireframe, CRAP principles, and user-centered design make structure and interaction clearer.
cautionAndMisconceptionsEn: A wireframe is a planning blueprint, not a finished visual design.
User-centered design prioritizes user needs rather than the creator’s preference.

lessons.title: Methods for Evaluating Websites

objectives.textEn: Distinguish qualitative from quantitative evaluation, and explain the major indicators used in web analytics.
objectives.textAr: التمييز بين التقييم النوعي والكمي وشرح المؤشرات الرئيسية المستخدمة في تحليلات الويب.

objectives.textEn: Explain how heuristic evaluation works, and why combining both approaches gives a clearer picture of a website.
objectives.textAr: شرح كيفية عمل التقييم الاستدلالي وسبب إعطاء الجمع بين النهجين صورة أوضح عن الموقع.

lessons.knowledgeSummaryEn: Qualitative evaluation explains user voices and behavior, quantitative evaluation measures usage, and heuristic review uses expert rules; combining them gives a fuller picture.
cautionAndMisconceptionsEn: Page views alone do not explain why users leave.
Qualitative and quantitative evidence answer different questions and should not be collapsed into one measure.

lessons.title: The Iterative Improvement Process for Websites

objectives.textEn: Explain the PDCA cycle and the steps of design thinking as ways of improving a website.
objectives.textAr: شرح دورة PDCA وخطوات التفكير التصميمي باعتبارهما طريقتين لتحسين الموقع.

objectives.textEn: Describe how A/B testing compares two options using real data, and explain why improvement is repeated in cycles.
objectives.textAr: وصف كيفية مقارنة اختبار A/B بين خيارين باستخدام بيانات حقيقية وشرح سبب تكرار التحسين في دورات.

lessons.knowledgeSummaryEn: Website improvement is cyclical: PDCA, design thinking, and controlled A/B tests use evidence to refine one change at a time.
cautionAndMisconceptionsEn: A/B testing should isolate the changed element as far as possible.
A website is not finished after one PDCA cycle; improvement repeats.

parts.title: Part 2
parts.descriptionEn: Data Collection and Cleaning; Analysis and Communication; Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence.
parts.descriptionAr: جمع البيانات وتنقيتها؛ التحليل والتواصل؛ التعلم الآلي والذكاء الاصطناعي.

lessons.title: Methods of Data Collection

objectives.textEn: Distinguish primary from secondary data and explain when each is appropriate.
objectives.textAr: التمييز بين البيانات الأولية والثانوية وشرح الوقت المناسب لاستخدام كل منهما.

objectives.textEn: Explain how sampling works, and describe how sampling bias can lead to confident but wrong conclusions.
objectives.textAr: شرح كيفية عمل أخذ العينات ووصف كيف يمكن لتحيز العينة أن يؤدي إلى استنتاجات واثقة لكنها خاطئة.

lessons.knowledgeSummaryEn: Trustworthy analysis starts with a collection plan, appropriate primary or secondary data, and an unbiased sample representing a population.
cautionAndMisconceptionsEn: A sample is not the whole population.
A confident conclusion can still be wrong when the sample is biased.

lessons.title: Data Cleaning and Transformation

objectives.textEn: Explain how missing values, outliers, and duplicate data are handled when cleaning a dataset.
objectives.textAr: شرح كيفية التعامل مع القيم المفقودة والقيم الشاذة والبيانات المكررة عند تنظيف مجموعة البيانات.

objectives.textEn: Describe data type conversion, normalization and standardization, and the reshaping of data to fit a purpose.
objectives.textAr: وصف تحويل أنواع البيانات والتطبيع والتوحيد وإعادة تشكيل البيانات لتناسب الغرض.

lessons.knowledgeSummaryEn: Cleaning fixes data quality problems; transformation changes type, scale, or shape so the data fits the intended analysis.
cautionAndMisconceptionsEn: Cleaning is not always deleting rows; the treatment depends on the meaning and purpose of the data.
Normalization, standardization, and reshaping are different operations.

lessons.title: Open Data and APIs

objectives.textEn: Explain what open data is and identify major reliable sources of it.
objectives.textAr: شرح ماهية البيانات المفتوحة وتحديد مصادرها الرئيسية الموثوقة.

objectives.textEn: Describe how data is obtained through an API, and explain the importance of terms of use and source citation.
objectives.textAr: وصف كيفية الحصول على البيانات من خلال واجهة برمجة التطبيقات وشرح أهمية شروط الاستخدام وتوثيق المصدر.

lessons.knowledgeSummaryEn: Open data can be reused, but APIs, terms of use, rate limits, and source citation govern responsible access and analysis.
cautionAndMisconceptionsEn: Publicly available data is not automatically free of usage conditions.
Using an API still requires checking terms of use and citing the source.

lessons.title: Statistical Inference

objectives.textEn: Explain the difference between point estimation and interval estimation, including the meaning of a confidence level.
objectives.textAr: شرح الفرق بين التقدير النقطي والتقدير الفتري، بما في ذلك معنى مستوى الثقة.

objectives.textEn: Describe the procedure of hypothesis testing, and explain the cautions needed when interpreting its results.
objectives.textAr: وصف إجراءات اختبار الفرضيات وشرح الاحتياطات اللازمة عند تفسير نتائجه.

lessons.knowledgeSummaryEn: Statistical inference reasons from a sample to a population and measures uncertainty through estimation and hypothesis testing.
cautionAndMisconceptionsEn: Statistical significance is not the same as practical importance.
A p-value below a threshold does not make a conclusion certainly true.

lessons.title: Use and Evaluation of Regression Analysis

objectives.textEn: Explain the difference between simple and multiple regression, and what a regression model represents.
objectives.textAr: شرح الفرق بين الانحدار البسيط والمتعدد وما يمثله نموذج الانحدار.

objectives.textEn: Evaluate a regression model using R², RMSE, and MAE, and explain why a good fit does not prove causation.
objectives.textAr: تقييم نموذج الانحدار باستخدام R² وRMSE وMAE وشرح سبب عدم إثبات جودة المطابقة للسببية.

lessons.knowledgeSummaryEn: Regression expresses relationships as a model for prediction; R², RMSE, and MAE describe fit, but a good fit does not prove causation.
cautionAndMisconceptionsEn: Correlation is not causation.
A model is a simplified representation and must be evaluated for accuracy and limitations.

lessons.title: Data Visualization and Communication

objectives.textEn: Explain the role of data visualization and select suitable graphs, including for multiple variables.
objectives.textAr: شرح دور تصور البيانات واختيار الرسوم البيانية المناسبة، بما في ذلك الرسوم للمتغيرات المتعددة.

objectives.textEn: Apply data storytelling to communicate a clear and honest message from data.
objectives.textAr: تطبيق سرد البيانات للتواصل برسالة واضحة وصادقة مستندة إلى البيانات.

lessons.knowledgeSummaryEn: A visualization should reveal relevant patterns without hiding uncertainty or density; data storytelling connects a suitable chart to an honest message.
cautionAndMisconceptionsEn: A more decorative chart is not necessarily a clearer chart.
Overplotting can hide density and the chart type must fit the variables.

lessons.title: The Basics of Machine Learning

objectives.textEn: Explain the idea of machine learning and distinguish supervised, unsupervised, and reinforcement learning.
objectives.textAr: شرح فكرة تعلم الآلة والتمييز بين التعلم الخاضع للإشراف وغير الخاضع للإشراف والتعلم بالتعزيز.

objectives.textEn: Describe classification, clustering, and reinforcement learning with examples, and explain the limits caused by data bias and the black-box problem.
objectives.textAr: وصف التصنيف والتجميع والتعلم بالتعزيز مع أمثلة وشرح القيود الناتجة عن تحيز البيانات ومشكلة الصندوق الأسود.

lessons.knowledgeSummaryEn: Machine learning learns patterns from data through supervised, unsupervised, or reinforcement approaches; data bias and opaque reasoning limit trust.
cautionAndMisconceptionsEn: More examples do not guarantee fairness when the examples are biased.
Classification, clustering, and reinforcement learning solve different kinds of tasks.

lessons.title: Neural Networks and Deep Learning

objectives.textEn: Describe the structure of a neural network and explain how a single neuron processes its inputs.
objectives.textAr: وصف بنية الشبكة العصبية وشرح كيفية معالجة عصبون واحد لمدخلاته.

objectives.textEn: Explain what deep learning is, and why stacking many hidden layers brought a leap in AI performance.
objectives.textAr: شرح ماهية التعلم العميق وسبب إحداث تكديس طبقات مخفية كثيرة قفزة في أداء الذكاء الاصطناعي.

lessons.knowledgeSummaryEn: Neural networks connect weighted neurons in layers; deep learning stacks hidden layers to learn hierarchical features.
cautionAndMisconceptionsEn: A single neuron is not a whole deep network.
Depth refers to layered representation learning, not simply a larger dataset.

lessons.title: Large Language Models (LLM) and Generative AI
lessons.titleAr: نماذج اللغة الكبيرة (LLM) والذكاء الاصطناعي التوليدي

objectives.textEn: Explain how a language model generates text by predicting the next word, and why this causes hallucination.
objectives.textAr: شرح كيفية توليد النموذج اللغوي للنص بالتنبؤ بالكلمة التالية وسبب تسبب ذلك في الهلوسة.

objectives.textEn: Describe what makes a language model large, and explain the roles of RLHF tuning and multimodality.
objectives.textAr: وصف ما يجعل النموذج اللغوي كبيرًا وشرح أدوار ضبط RLHF وتعدد الوسائط.

lessons.knowledgeSummaryEn: A language model repeatedly predicts a plausible next word; scale, parameters, RLHF, and multimodality expand capability, but fluency is not truth.
cautionAndMisconceptionsEn: Next-word prediction optimizes plausibility, not guaranteed factual accuracy.
RLHF improves alignment and helpfulness; it does not make every answer true.
Multimodality means handling multiple data types, not merely arithmetic over numbers.

knowledgeRelations.reason: IT development and social impact provide context for AI as a technology.
AI categories precede their daily-life and industry applications.
AI use cases and limitations precede explicit ethics and accountability.
Cryptography and authentication are foundational controls before network architecture.
Security design controls precede response and risk prioritization.
The three-tier web model precedes communication details.
Client/server communication precedes frontend implementation technologies.
Media choice precedes user-centered information design.
Collection quality precedes cleaning and transformation.
Clean and shaped data supports responsible API/open-data use.
Collection and sourcing precede inference from samples.
Inference and uncertainty support model evaluation.
Regression output is one source for visualization and communication.
ML categories precede neural networks and deep learning.
Deep learning concepts precede LLM and generative AI.
The AI/ML nesting introduced in Part 1 is expanded in Unit 7.
